target.title: fix(imessage): recognize bare hex group chat identifiers as chat targets
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #89235, which was closed as "wrong repo" despite ClawSweeper's own review confirming a source-level repro in this exact repo (`extensions/imessage/src/normalize.ts:55`, `src/utils.ts:55`, `src/cron/isolated-agent/delivery-target.ts:299`).

A 32-char hex iMessage group chat identifier (the format `imsg` returns for group chats) has no explicit `chat_identifier:` prefix, so it fell through to E.164 phone-number normalization in both:

- `extensions/imessage/src/targets.ts` (`normalizeIMessageHandle` / `parseIMessageTarget` — the actual send path)
- `extensions/imessage/src/normalize.ts` (`normalizeIMessageHandle` / `normalizeIMessageMessagingTarget` — the cron/announce delivery-target resolver)

`normalizeE164` strips every non-digit character and prepends `+`, so `7d5297154d5f436d83dbbdf03fcc8fdd` became `+75297154543683038` — a bogus phone number. Cron/announce delivery then reported `delivered: true` while silently sending to a nonexistent recipient, giving a false success signal with no error surfaced.

## Fix

Detect bare 32-char hex strings before the E.164 fallback in both normalizers, and route them as `chat_identifier` targets — the same representation already used for an explicit `chat_identifier:<id>` prefix, which the send path (`imsg send --chat-identifier <id>`) already handles correctly. Also updated `looksLikeIMessageExplicitTargetId` / `looksLikeIMessageTargetId` so the two id-detection helpers stay consistent with the parser.

## Test plan

- Added regression tests in `normalize.test.ts` and `targets.test.ts` using the exact hex ID from the original report.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/imessage/src/normalize.test.ts extensions/imessage/src/targets.test.ts src/cron/isolated-agent/delivery-target.test.ts extensions/imessage/src/send.test.ts` — 72/72 pass (3 new).
- Full `extension-imessage` project: 679/679 pass.
- Full `cron` project: 1231/1231 pass.
- `tsc -p tsconfig.extensions.json --noEmit` clean.
- `oxlint` on changed files clean.
